item.tib: ma rgyud gsang mchog gzhi ye sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud
item.coloph: ces pa'i 'di ni lug ris su bgyis mkhan kho bo rgyal dbang ming gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel
item.note: p. no. 1 is evidently to be read as p. no. 6. the final two fols. are both marked '33', the first two pages of the text are marked vol. no 31, while the remainder is marked vol. 32. gter-ston gu-ru rnon-rtse (b. 1136) discovered this, and many of the following texts, at dung-phor in rta-nag. see karmay, treasury, pp. 166-167. the tbmc edition (1971), p. 68.3 has the following colophon: dung phor gter nas bla ma 'gu rus bton pa'i dar dkar dngos la / bdag btsun pa gzhon gyis zhus nas dag par bris // de'i phyag dpe ma 'gyur ba la sgom pa g.yung drung gi bris // de'i bu dpe ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bris la bshus nas // 'jad pa zhang ston bsod nams dpal gyis zhus // de la chen po bsod rgyal gyis zhus // de nas rim par rgyud. both the tbmc and the present edition have 10 chaps, but ntkc nonetheless mentions 13 chapters. see information in the following texts: spa-ston, history (as contained in sfhb), p. 762.7. shar-rdza, history (beijing edition), p. 294.18. this text is also contained in our vol. 120.1.
